items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 as a fractured internal fitting due to frost; reference Case 25 shows t between 51 and 54 for this exact item under the same peril and policy.

Leak location equipment for covered frost escape (2.4.6, 5.2.2); Case 25 shows t below 28, possibly 0—lowest charge proven too high.
Return visit by same undertaking for same event is not separately indemnified (7.1.11); reference cases show t = 0 for such lines.

items.description: Facade frost damage - remove loose and spalled plaster (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(a) as making good frost-damaged external surface; peril is agreed. Reference Case 25: similar work excluded without endorsement, but here endorsement is present, so t > 0. Moderate for 2 pcs (likely two areas or stages).
Covered as part of making good the damaged area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)); reference Case 25 shows t = 0 without endorsement, but here peril is agreed.
Covered as part of reinstating the affected area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(c)); reference Case 25 logic applies, but peril is agreed.
Covered as part of the finish system for the affected area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)); reference Case 25 logic applies, but peril is agreed.
Covered if necessary before repair of affected part (2.6.2, 7.1.7(c)); reference Case 25 logic applies, but peril is agreed.
Covered as part of the finish system for the affected area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)); reference Case 25 logic applies, but peril is agreed.
Labour for covered repair (2.6.2, 7.1.7(f)); reference Case 25 shows t = 0 without endorsement, but here peril is agreed.
Access provision for covered work (2.6.2, 7.1.8); reference Case 25 logic applies, but peril is agreed.
